", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“Thousands, sir?”", "sha256": "537c4fc32068f89082f32c34f0c093933bbb7b748c7b73b6f98d661d7bec1b39", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[748]", "source_html": "

“Thousands, sir?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "Again Henry shook his head.", "sha256": "8b4b4e62f78396a770213019150ce2f74c0a6f2c2e468816d1fb72bbdb02eed3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[749]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“Millions, sir?”", "sha256": "ce942dc278e5e70ffe3501edf08120d99d72c07da9d1737da37adda81e8e9b65", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[750]", "source_html": "

“Millions, sir?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“Now you’re talking,” Henry answered. “Mr. Francis Morgan is rich enough to buy almost all of the Republic of Panama, with the Canal cut out of the deal.”", "sha256": "fcd6a842ce500598994ef914fc187b9675855db70a688cbbd30cfbb3b2db02d2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[751]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u010-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "The negro-Indian mariner looked his unbelief to Enrico Solano, who replied:", "sha256": "9fb0fb6fae5e785991de56d228c8462e0f83cf41185a457f51a139e76f2bbd7c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[752]", "source_html": "

Glancing back from time to time, he saw the party on the beach shoulder the baggage and disappear into the dense green wall of vegetation.", "sha256": "fff03286ae086e9f993b40a92cf2a7c769dd2fb22a1ca9b8c1064f100a483f2f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[758]", "source_html": "

Leoncia, beside her father, walked in the lead. Her brothers, Ricardo and Alesandro, in the middle, were burdened with the dunnage, as were Francis and Henry, who brought up the rear. The talk was in rapid-fire Spanish, and the request for horses preferred and qualifiedly granted, ere the introduction of the two Morgans took place. The haciendado’s horse, after the Latin fashion, was immediately Leoncia’s, and, without ado, he shortened the stirrups and placed her astride in the saddle. A murrain, he explained, had swept his plantation of riding animals; but his chief overseer still possessed a fair-conditioned one which was Enrico’s as soon as it could be procured.
